title: Counterexamples to the xz-Conjecture and the Mathieu Conjecture for SU(2)
summary: Let \[ {\mathcal I}(h)=\int_0^1\int_{\mathbb T}h(x,z)\,\frac{dz}{2πiz}\,dx \qquad \bigl(h\in{\mathbb C}[x,z,z^{-1}]\bigr). \] We give the three-term Laurent polynomial \[ f(x,z)=(1-z^{-1})\bigl((1-x)+xz\bigr) \] for which \[ {\mathcal I}(f^n)=0, \qquad {\mathcal I}(z^{-1}f^n)=\frac{(-1)^{n-1}}{n+1}\neq0 \qquad(n\geq1). \] Since ${\operatorname{Sp}}(f)=\{-1,0,1\}$, this disproves the $xz$-conjecture already with one interval variable and one torus variable, and it also shows that $\ker{\mathcal I}$ is not a Mathieu--Zhao subspace.
